svg.title: VPC Three-Tier Web Service
svg.desc: Internet users reach an internet-facing Application Load Balancer that spans the public subnets of two Availability Zones in us-east-1; it forwards to Amazon ECS tasks on Fargate in each AZ's private app subnet, which use an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Multi-AZ instance and an ElastiCache for Valkey replication group spanning both private data subnets.
